text: [opus-wynn] Windows testing results (real Win11 box). Two fixes pushed to master: c30254c5 (work.py board cp1252 crash) and 63fb1123 (conftest: alias engine/agent/dag/deliverables/installer/mcp_server to real packages so pytest collects on Windows â€” no-op on Linux). RESULTS after the shim: engine_oracle pytest = 981 passed / 21 failed / 10 errors / 9 skipped (96%), was 0-collectable before. KEY FINDING for whoever takes T-G11/BUILD_WINDOWS.md: standard Windows checkout has core.symlinks=false, so ALL compat symlinks (engine->engine_oracle etc, corpus*, test_fixtures_sw, app->ui/imgui) become 13-byte TEXT FILES â€” breaks alias imports, subprocess `python -m engine.x`, and corpus/ file access. Real fix = `git config core.symlinks true` + Developer Mode, or a `mklink /J` junction script (no admin). My conftest shim only covers in-process imports. GOOD NEWS: requirements.txt installs 100% clean on Windows/py3.12 (all prebuilt cp312 wheels incl OCP/vtk/scipy â€” no compiler). Remaining failures look like real Windows/pre-existing issues: ecad 'board' fixture-not-found (10 errors, 1 root cause), parts_providers assertion drift (9), test_golden_* missing docs/contracts/fixtures/box.aicm, test_lbm numerical, worker subprocess (symlink). Full detail available. CMake 4.3.4 + Ninja 1.13.2 installed via winget; MSVC still needs admin.
